E1 directly demonstrates all these effects in AlCrFeMnNi, a closely related HEA, under the same 5 µm, 20 kHz conditions. However, the premise that these results transfer to the cobalt-free AlCrFeNiSi system is an extrapolation not directly supported by the cited evidence, representing a minor gap.
